    Recommend the Best Dock for Pickup or Drop-Off

    recommend_dock.Rd

    Given a data frame of candidate docks with their availability probabilities and distances (or walk times), applies a threshold rule to select the best one for the rider.

    Decision rule:

    1. Drop any candidate whose probability is NA.

    2. Among candidates with p >= threshold, choose the one with the smallest minutes (ties broken by higher p).

    3. If no candidate meets the threshold, choose the one with the highest p (ties broken by smallest minutes). A warning is attached to the output.

    recommend_dock(candidates, threshold = 0.9)

    Arguments

    candidates

    A data frame with at least the following columns:

    dock_id

    Character. Dock identifier.

    minutes

    Numeric. Estimated walk (or ride) time to this dock in minutes.

    p

    Numeric in 0,1. Availability probability from get_bike_availability() or get_slot_availability().

    Any additional columns (e.g. name, lat, lon) are passed through to the output unchanged.

    threshold

    Numeric in (0, 1]. The minimum acceptable probability. Defaults to 0.90 (90% confidence a bike/slot will be there).

    Value

    A named list with:

    choice

    A one-row data frame: the recommended dock with all columns from candidates.

    alternatives

    A data frame of up to two runner-up docks (the next-closest that also meet the threshold, if any).

    reason

    Character. One of "threshold met" or "no dock met threshold – best available returned".

    Author

    Big Red Crew

    Examples

    candidates <- data.frame(
  dock_id = c("DockA", "DockB", "DockC"),
  minutes = c(10, 20, 5),
  p       = c(0.61, 0.95, 0.39)
)
# DockB wins: only one that meets the 0.90 threshold
recommend_dock(candidates, threshold = 0.90)
#> $choice
#>   dock_id minutes    p
#> 1   DockB      20 0.95
#> 
#> $alternatives
#> data frame with 0 columns and 0 rows
#> 
#> $reason
#> [1] "threshold met"
#> 

# Lower threshold: DockA (10 min, p=0.61) beats DockB (20 min, p=0.95)
recommend_dock(candidates, threshold = 0.60)
#> $choice
#>   dock_id minutes    p
#> 1   DockA      10 0.61
#> 
#> $alternatives
#>   dock_id minutes    p
#> 2   DockB      20 0.95
#> 
#> $reason
#> [1] "threshold met"
#>
